deck.name: Semiconductor Channel Decision Deck — CRN Closed Cohort

waivers.TEXT_LOW_CONTRAST: The heuristic cannot resolve several brand-accent labels against their immediate card or dark-bar fills; the required OfficeCLI render was inspected and the labels are legible.
waivers.TEXT_OVERFLOW_RISK: All flagged regions use bounded PowerPoint autofit and were checked in the OfficeCLI render plus the five-sheet slide preview; no visible collisions or clipped copy remain.
waivers.TEXT_TOO_SMALL: Compact table headers, evidence labels, citations, and repeated profile metadata use 8.5-11.5 point text; all substantive narrative text remains larger and is checked in the real Office render.
waivers.SLIDE_WORD_COUNT: The flagged slides are comparison tables, profile cards, or methodology appendices whose structured rows remain scannable at the 12-point body minimum.
waivers.SLIDE_SHAPE_COUNT: Evidence bars and the role-specific heatmap intentionally exceed the generic shape budget; the geometry is regular, native, and verified in the real Office render.
waivers.DECK_COLOR_COUNT: The 14 explicit colors are the established branded palette plus neutral table fills and status accents; no ungoverned decorative colors were introduced.
waivers.LAYOUT_REPETITION: Repeated company profiles and three partner-lens heatmaps intentionally use identical geometry to preserve cross-company and cross-lens comparability.
